request.description:
Beyond the three tests hv3 fixed, the harness node suite's other load-dependent tests still carry the quiet-host 30s vitest default, and the harness-timeout-discipline guard does not scan them: its criterion is `Harness.open` inside the it body of test/node files only, so process-driving tests (boundary-guard, tracked-bash, factory-sandbox-env, the rest of local-host — 7wg's named tests among them) and the workerd pool's full-Harness tests (the gateway test's open sits inside a helper) are all unbounded and unguarded. Under synthetic 12x oversubscription (spawn storms; harsher than the observed load 23-47) 24 node-suite tests failed at 30s, beforeEach hooks timed out at the 30s hookTimeout, and a 120s bound was crossed by a git-heavy test (138s). Proposal: extend the discipline guard's criterion (workerd-suite files; tests that spawn processes or drive the door) and state load-sized bounds where the criterion lands.
evidence: synthetic-contention run log: 24 failed incl. 'Hook timed out in 30000ms' (beforeEach) and 'Test timed out in 120000ms' for the git-heavy test at 138s; harness/test/node/harness-timeout-discipline.test.ts scans test/node/*.test.ts for in-body Harness.open only
